sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate represents calculation-input provenance, member parts, flange-fitted status, or shear-area inclusion/exclusion relationships; the quantity properties and classes provided cannot encode the required conditional constraint.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only sh:or with constraints that encode the actual calculation evidence: section modulus and shear area must be calculated using net thicknesses for the web, attached shell plating, and the flange when fitted, while shear-area material may cover the full member depth but must exclude attached shell plating. The current generic thickness presence check neither identifies those parts nor proves use/exclusion, and its branches incorrectly allow either calculation independently.
